case.title: FePS3, negative control
case.reason: An Ising antiferromagnet where uniform ferromagnetic-macrospin reversal is not the relevant switching mode. Included to show the machinery's honest limit.
case.expectation: The macrospin optimal-control numbers are computed but flagged as not physically representative of the true antiferromagnetic switching; a number is not the same as a result.

material.name: FePS3
material.notes: The negative control. An Ising antiferromagnet (Neel temperature 118 K), where uniform field-driven reversal of a single sublattice is not the relevant switching mode. Included so the product can show what the optimal-control machinery says when its own assumptions (a single ferromagnetic macrospin) do not hold, rather than silently producing a number.
